domain: Academic Research Publications and Bibliographic Management
scenario:
A global academic institution is implementing a comprehensive Research Publications and Bibliographic Management System to streamline the management of scholarly works, including journal articles, theses, and datasets. This system will cater to researchers, authors, and academic departments, facilitating the management and dissemination of various types of publications.

The platform will support the storage and retrieval of bibliographic data, publication metadata, and associated digital object identifiers (DOIs) for scholarly works. It will enable users to track publication types, manage author affiliations, and link related publications through shared bibliographic records. Additionally, the system will provide tools for authors to update their publication records, including URLs to online resources and publication year details.

The system will also feature advanced search capabilities, allowing users to filter publications by type, year, author, and journal. Detailed reporting and analytics tools will help institutions monitor publication trends, assess research output, and identify prominent authors and affiliations.

Furthermore, the platform will incorporate role-based access controls to protect sensitive bibliographic data and ensure that only authorized users can edit publication records. Collaboration features will allow researchers to share and co-author publications, facilitating academic collaboration across different institutions.
